hazards.name: Lack of marked mid-block crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the roadway without the protection or visibility provided by a marked crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the roadway

hazards.name: Low-hanging utility wires
hazards.description: A dense cluster of overhead wires hangs relatively low across the street and sidewalk area.
hazards.location_in_image: Spanning the upper portion of the image

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along both sides of the street can obscure pedestrians, especially children, from the view of oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the visible block.

hazards.name: Uneven sidewalk surface
hazards.description: The brick pavers on the sidewalk appear uneven in several places, creating a potential trip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground sidewalk area

hazards.name: Parked vehicle visual obstruction
hazards.description: On-street parked vehicles can block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb block sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line where cars are parked

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the curb with no planting strip or furniture zone to separate pedestrians from traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: The interface between the sidewalk and the parked cars

hazards.name: Garage Entrance Conflict
hazards.description: A wide garage entrance crosses the sidewalk, creating a point where vehicles may exit across the pedestrian path with limited visibility.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-right, the dark opening in the brick building.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: The right side of the street lacks a paved walkway, forcing pedestrians to walk in the roadway or on uneven, vegetated ground.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway

hazards.name: Wide Driveway Conflict Point
hazards.description: A wide gated entrance to a parking lot creates a large area where vehicles cross the sidewalk, increasing the risk of pedestrian-vehicle conflict.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image at the black metal gate.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at intersections or mid-block to provide designated pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add street trees on the left side to create a consistent buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway while organizing utilities.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair cracked and uneven sidewalk sections to improve accessibility and safety for all users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers during low-light conditions.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening or Pole Relocation
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk or relocate utility poles to the furniture zone to provide a clear, unobstructed path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Install Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add street lamps to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers at night.

interventions.title: Plant Street Trees
interventions.description: Introduce trees in the buffer strip to provide shade and create a more comfortable, traffic-calmed environment.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Install speed humps or cushions to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential area.

interventions.title: Relocate Waste Containers
interventions.description: Move the dumpsters to a designated off-street area or a protected enclosure in the parking lane to restore sidewalk width.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and pedestrian-ahead signage to improve safety for people crossing the street.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Repave the sidewalk to provide a smooth, level surface free of cracks and trip hazards.

interventions.title: Clear Walkway Delineation
interventions.description: Use pavement markings or different materials to clearly define the pedestrian path through the wide driveway area to prevent vehicle encroachment.

interventions.title: Obstruction Removal
interventions.description: Remove the abandoned shopping cart and enforce parking regulations to keep the walkway clear.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or street furniture zone to provide physical separation between the sidewalk and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Install Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add curb extensions at intersections to shorten crossing distances and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Add Street Trees and Buffer
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical barrier and improve the pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and security for pedestrians at night.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Treatment
interventions.description: Ensure the sidewalk material and level continue across the driveway to clearly signal pedestrian priority to drivers.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Add more street trees in the buffer zone to provide shade and a greater sense of enclosure, which naturally slows traffic.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical speed control measures to reduce vehicle speeds in this mixed-use area.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Add a high-visibility marked crosswalk to provide a designated and safer crossing point for residents.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Add a vegetated buffer between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical separation and improve the walking environment.

interventions.title: Driveway Pavement Markings
interventions.description: Apply high-visibility paint or different paving materials across the garage entrance to clearly define the pedestrian right-of-way and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Exit Warning System
interventions.description: Install sensors that trigger a visual or audible alert when a vehicle is exiting the garage to warn pedestrians on the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on the right side of the street to eliminate the gap in the pedestrian network.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Install street trees or large planters in a furniture zone to provide a physical buffer between pedestrians and the roadway and improve the microclimate.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near potential crossing points to improve visibility between motorists and pedestrians.
